# Manto negro (Manto Negro)

**Status: DRAFT** · world: [primigenia](../worlds/primigenia.md) · form: moss_lichen · id: `manto_negro`

Thriving on the terraces where hot-spring runoff cools below 70 °C, this dense microbial mat couples photosynthesis with sulfur oxidation (D22). Its black base captures the dense air’s diffused light (F4), while red-purple surface pigments screen the high-altitude UV flux (F14, D23). It converts vent gases and solar photons into lipid-rich filaments, sustaining specialized grazers and decomposers in an otherwise barren zone (D28).

**Habitats:** vents, caves
